files.schema.sop:
@time acts.schema
    noun="timeline"
    doc="Moments in a row by time: the things of the session that have a time."
    acts=make
    acts=remove
    acts=change
    acts=ask
    acts=copy
    acts=send
    acts=undo
    acts=redo
    limit.items=60
    limit.history=30
    tabOnly=yes
    hooks=hooks.mjs

@time.view acts.view
    aspects=temporal
    word=timeline
    word=time_line
    word=calendar

@time.moment acts.kind
    plural=moments
    named=yes
    aspect=temporal
    word=event
    word=events
    word=day
    word=days
    word=weekday
    word=weekdays
    word=month
    word=months
    word=season
    word=seasons
    word=holiday
    word=holidays
    word=birthday
    word=birthdays

@time.when acts.attr
    of=moment
    type=number
    min=0
    max=3000
    default=1
    word=year
    word=hour
    word=date
    word=time
    more=later
    less=earlier
files.world.sop:
@world.plan.timeline core.world
    namespace=plan.timeline
    version=0.1.0
    legend=$legend.plan.timeline
    imports=world.core
    imports=world.lang.common
    imports=world.acts
    formalization=rules
    language=en
    status=fixture
    tab=timeline
    tabTitle="Timeline"
    tabAlias=timeline
    tabOrder=97
    tabKind=tool
    title="Timeline"
    doc="T6-lite (spec 23): a view declared by schema.sop alone, with no code of its own. It shows the things of the session that have a temporal aspect (days, months, seasons, events, birthdays) as moments in a row by their time attribute. Its lexicon, patterns, operations, templates and ops.mjs are generated by scripts/build-schema-world.mjs. Hand-built; not produced by the C1 workflow."
